selected.text: You have taken up a good occupation which deserves praise … give thanks to God that you are successful in these services
selected.reason: Praise for an occupation, whose actual kind requires source context. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: The sacrificial ghazal was studied carefully. Indeed it is eloquent, profound, original and delightful. Those who became attracted upon reading it and sought the path to the neighborhood of the Kind Beloved are justified.
selected.reason: Specific literary appreciation of a ghazal. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: The Tongue of Glory in the prison of Akka beareth witness to the oneness of God, exalted be His glory, and that He hath no peer or likeness, and testifieth that Jinab-i-Javad, upon him be the Glory of God, together with the papers present in that house, hath arisen to serve from the beginning and hath not, according to his capacity, fallen short in rendering service and showing hospitality for the sake of God. He hath ever been and is mentioned in Our presence.
selected.reason: Hospitality and service in proportion to capacity. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Thou art not heartless, for the heart is a dwelling-place of the Friend and is with Him. And thou art not poor, for through thy love for the Manifest Beauty thou art accounted among the most wealthy of His servants. Thou hast never been and art not a stranger, rather thou art near.
selected.reason: Reassurance about poverty and belonging. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: friends of 'Abdu'l-Baha! The honored Afnan of the Blessed Tree have loosed their tongues in praise of the Persian friends and ancient divine companions, saying that they truly desire truthfulness and friendship and peace and worship of truth. They are filled with the wine of the love of God and are diffusing the fragrances of divine knowledge. They cause no harm to any group in the world and are benevolent and well-behaved toward all peoples and nations
selected.reason: Harmlessness and goodwill toward all peoples. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: For bounties from the Kingdom of God have been ordained for that family and household that cannot be imagined, since they burned away the veil of tests with a flame and ignited a face in the gathering of the Covenant. They chanted the verses of the Covenant in the assemblage of the women of the horizons with melody, song, harp and music.
selected.reason: A family’s devotional music and shared expression. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: the Persian friends are successful in friendship and truthfulness, and with heart and soul desire peace and reconciliation for all people. They have pure hearts and radiant souls.
selected.reason: Peace and reconciliation as praised qualities. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: The article which you wrote and which was published in the newspaper was noted. It has been circulated throughout the East, and just and enlightened souls among the scholars and learned ones of the East and the wise and great ones have highly praised you, and it has been promoted.
selected.reason: Recognition of a published article’s reception. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: O thou proficient poet! Thou hast cheered the heart of Fuzulî and freed the soul of Ruhi-yi Bagdadi … In short, thou hast marvelled the minds of the Turkish poets
selected.reason: A poet’s contribution to a linguistic tradition. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: He [Shayku'r-Ra'is] is one of the noblest men of Persia. Learned and eloquent and as a former representative of the people in the Persian parliament he is made famous throughout Persia. He is a scion of nobility.
selected.reason: A reported appreciation of learning and public service. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: There I found wonderful Baha'is. They were the embodiments of love and faith. They brought me health and joy. In many respects the German believers are unique and peerless. They are faithful, strong and firm. I loved them very much. Their attraction and the fire of their love are an example and their genuine spirit of hospitality and kindness is worthy of imitation. They are the brilliant stars in the heaven of Baha.
selected.reason: Reported appreciation of hospitality across countries. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Praise befitteth and is meet for the Lord of existence Who, through His pure bounty, hath made manifest the world of being through the Word of His command, and hath ordained such means as lead to fellowship, unity, comfort and concord, that all may attain true repose in the cradle of security and peace, and become occupied in and give voice to divine praise. Great is His favor and His bestowals are beyond measure and reckoning.
selected.reason: Conditions of security, unity and peace that support praise. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: The beloved letter arrived and gladdened the sorrowful heart with news of the health, wellbeing and steadfastness of the honored Afnan, upon him be the peace of the All-Merciful, and that blessed being. The One God is witness that mention of the friends and loved ones brings joy and delight
selected.reason: Reciprocal comfort through news of friends. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: All praise and gratitude belong to the True One, glorified be His majesty, Who created hearts and guided them to one another. He is the Almighty Who bestows eternal glory upon dust and places the crown of wealth upon the head of the poor.
selected.reason: Hearts drawn together beyond outward poverty. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: O Amanullah! Blessed art thou, and blessed is he who reared thee, and blessed is he whom God hath aided to show kindness unto thee.
selected.reason: Blessing extended to those who rear and care for someone. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Praise be to God, the first day of the feast has come to an end with the blessed, right and upright deeds of His Majesty Sultan Abdul-Hamid, may God, blessed and exalted be He, strengthen him.
selected.reason: Praise of a ruler’s particular deeds rather than blanket endorsement. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Praise be to God that after the fire of oppression, the light of justice shone forth from the horizon of the glorious government's heaven.
selected.reason: Praise for relief from oppression through justice. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: The Lord of all worlds is sanctified beyond praise, eulogy and comprehension of the dwellers of the mortal realm. In truth, until now He hath been neither known nor described. The attributes of all beings, from the most exalted to the lowliest, ultimately refer to those steadfast, firm, upright, content and well-pleasing souls.
selected.reason: The limits of language and comprehension in praising God. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: O Zoroastrian friends! Jinab-i-Jamshid has written a letter mentioning those spiritual friends who, praise be to God, possess hearts pure as mirrors and souls aflame with ardor, who turn their faces toward the Abha Kingdom, who engage in supplication and devotion to the highest horizon, who chant the verses of unity day and night, who occupy themselves at morn and eve with glorifying and praising the peerless and glorious Lord, who strive to spread the divine traces and hasten to give glad tidings to the sanctified souls of the human world. They are radiant lights and brilliant lamps.
selected.reason: Shared devotion among friends of Zoroastrian background. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: O fragrant visitor! Hafiz of Shiraz says in his Divan: "The Persian-speaking Turks are the bestowers of life." You are that Persian-speaking Turk who would converse in Persian with utmost sweetness and charm, and would bring joy and gladness to me and the divine friends
selected.reason: A literary allusion used to appreciate a visitor. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Do you know what the harp and lute are saying? … Drink wine in secret, for they issue decrees of heresy
selected.reason: Poetic imagery requiring its complete source frame. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Praise befitteth the Lord of existence and the Sovereign of the seen and unseen, Who, through a single effulgence from the Day-Star of His Name, the Self-Subsisting, hath made manifest the mysteries of the blessed words "And when the trumpet is blown a second time, at once they will be standing and looking on." Great indeed is this Day, and greater still are its requirements.
selected.reason: Praise accompanied by recognition of responsibility. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Praise be to God Who hath sent down the laws and made them a stronghold for His servants and a cause for the preservation of His creation.
selected.reason: Laws understood as preserving and protecting. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: The world is a manifest Book which in every moment mentions and reveals its mysteries. Therefore its events do not hold back the people of insight and the companions of the Most Great Vision from what God hath willed.
selected.reason: The world as a book of signs. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Praise be to God Who has made His remembrance and glorification the food of His loved ones, and His love and good-pleasure their paradise.
selected.reason: Remembrance as nourishment. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Praise, eternal and sanctified above all likeness and comparison, befitteth the Lord of existence Who hath caused all things in the world to appear like the letters of a book in their standing, sitting, prostration, bowing, submission and humility. All things have appeared from a single word, yet how vastly different are their effects, fruits, colors, tastes, motions and stillness.
selected.reason: Unity of origin alongside diversity of created effects. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Praise be to God, and peace and blessings be upon the Prophets and Messengers, whom God made the manifestations of His Self, the dawning-places of His revelation, the recipients of His knowledge, the treasuries of the pearls of His recognition, and the repositories of His precious trusts; and upon their friends, their loved ones, and their children. Then effulgent, radiant, resplendent and brilliant blessings be upon their Lord, their Source, their Seal, their First and their Last, and upon His children and companions who forsook the world for the Cause of God, the Lord of all worlds.
selected.reason: Praise and blessings across prophetic history. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: These are souls who have believed in their Lord, found peace in the bounty of their Creator, been content with the decree of their Fashioner, and have grown from the blessed Tree and holy Lote-Tree. They have grown tall, branched forth, put forth leaves, blossomed and borne fruit. Their fruit is everlasting, their root is firm, their fragrance wafting, fresh and verdant through Thy ancient bounties
selected.reason: Growth and fruitfulness as devotional imagery. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Praise, sanctified above the mysteries of the pen and the eloquence of the tongue, befitteth the Lord of all mankind, whose mercy and grace have reached such heights that the tongues of them that are nigh unto Him are powerless and fall short of their mention. Like unto a tender and loving father, He hath guided and trained these servants as children, causing the pearls of His hidden counsels to stream forth from His Pen by night and by day, and manifesting from the Tongue of His grandeur blessed admonitions at all times, that perchance His servants might be delivered from the wilderness of error and turn towards and enter the realm of guidance.
selected.reason: Divine guidance figured as parental care. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Praise, sanctified from all beginning and end, befitteth and beseemeth the Most Holy and Most Exalted Court of that Eternal Being, Who, through the effulgent rays of the Sun of Yathrib and Batha, hath adorned the people of the mortal realm -- who were deprived of knowledge and learning -- with the ornament of wisdom, utterance, knowledge and understanding
selected.reason: Recognition of knowledge associated with Islamic revelation. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: All praise befitteth the Sovereign of the realm of the Kingdom, Who fulfilled His promise and illumined the world and its peoples with the light of His Most Great Name through the appearance of Him Who was promised. The tongues of all created things bear witness to His grace, His bounty, His might, His grandeur, and His glory. Glory, peace and radiance be upon His loved ones, whom God hath adorned with the ornament of chastity and trustworthiness, and made them the manifestations of His most beautiful names in His dominion.
selected.reason: Divine praise linked with chastity and trustworthiness. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Your letter arrived and its reading brought me such joy that I cannot describe, for it is evidence of your noble nature, strength of purpose, and sincerity of intention.
selected.reason: A letter’s sincerity as a source of joy. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: All regions have been illumined by the Day-Star of the World, blessed are those who have attained. The call hath been raised from the sacred lote-tree on Mount Sinai, blessed are those who harken. All regions have been perfumed by the fragrances of holiness diffused from the hallowed and snow-white Spot, blessed are those who inhale.
selected.reason: Different senses as images of spiritual response. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Blessed is the soul that hath held fast unto the cord of patience and resignation in whatsoever hath befallen it in the path of God, the Lord of the mighty Throne.
selected.reason: Patience amid what has befallen a person. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Blessed are they who reflect and observe what hath come to pass in the past. For whosoever becometh aware shall attain unto the choice sealed wine through the blessing of the Name "the Self-Subsisting" and shall be adorned with the ornament of supreme steadfastness
selected.reason: Reflection on history as a praised activity. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Praised be the work of those who have arisen to serve the Cause in such wise that neither the clamor of the people deterred them nor the tyranny of those in the land frightened
selected.reason: Recognition of service under intimidation. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: O my Lord! O my Lord! These are the chosen ones whose faces are illumined with the light of guidance, who found the heavenly table pleasing to their tastes, who submitted willingly to every matter which happened in the land and sought help from the hosts of the Supreme Concourse. Their feet are indeed made firm, their banners hoisted, their deeds righteous and their actions just.
selected.reason: A prayer that joins steadfastness and just action. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: The services of that family from the beginning dawn of truth until this time are renowned throughout the world and witnessed by the spiritual ones. When a true lover's proof is in one's sleeve, no explanation is needed. Indeed, that family is deserving and worthy of every kind of bounty, and this recent service is added to those
selected.reason: Acknowledgment of successive generations of service. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: In truth, you are steadfast with heart and soul, and serve the Cause with all your might. In seeking God's good pleasure, there remains no approach you have not taken, and in exalting the Word of God, no strategy you have not employed.
selected.reason: Recognition of sustained resourcefulness. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: A hundred thousand praises and thanks befit and beseem the loved ones and the chosen ones of the Friend, who are detached from themselves and from the world, alive and steadfast through the name of the Desired One. Through tongue and utterance, through pen and deeds and actions, they summon the servants to the Dawning-Place of Revelation and the Dayspring of Inspiration. They speak with their tongues and gesture with their hands, and through movements of brow and head they draw the heedless to the realm of awareness and bestow wakefulness upon them that slumber.
selected.reason: Praise encompassing speech, writing and action. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Consider how a breeze hath wafted from the garden of his soul and heart, which hath made you heedful and aware, and caused you to become contemptuous and disgusted with self and desire.
selected.reason: A letter’s influence on its recipient’s self-understanding. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: He spread the divine fragrances and chanted the clear verses and explained the conclusive proofs and conveyed the words to every soul who strove with true striving and desired guidance.
selected.reason: Recognition of teaching suited to a sincere seeker. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: O loved ones of God! Praise God that you have entered beneath the shade of the banner raised by the Lord of Hosts … This honor and station is cause for pride, and this success and prosperity shine bright and luminous like a lamp and light. … Thanks be to God who has bestowed such bounty and freely given such favors
selected.reason: Gratitude for belonging and shared purpose. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: O faithful friends of the Beauty of Abha! Four hundred blessed souls from among the friends in the West have jointly sent this letter, making a covenant of unity, brotherhood and oneness with each other, establishing the foundation of fellowship
selected.reason: A jointly signed commitment to unity. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Blessed art thou for guiding certain souls unto the Kingdom of God and giving them to drink of the wine of the Love of God from the Chalice of His Guidance.
selected.reason: Recognition of helping others find spiritual nourishment. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Some of the friends who are engaged in serving the Cause and are adorned with goodly deeds and praiseworthy character are in truth among the pillars and chosen ones of the earth
selected.reason: Conduct as a support of community life. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Now it is the will of the merciful Lord to transform that thousand-year abasement and humiliation into glory and nobility, and to compensate for what was lost. The glance of favor has encompassed all and grace and mercy have been perfected. That wandering people has become the object of divine compassion and the reality of heavenly bounty has taken form.
selected.reason: Hope for a people with a history of exclusion. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: I praise thee O Thou Remover of Sorrows, Overlooker of faults, Rejoicer of hearts and the Illuminator of faces!
selected.reason: A prayer naming the removal of sorrow and overlooking faults. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Praise be to God Who hath perfumed the world with the fragrances of His revelation and illumined the hearts of the sincere with the light of His knowledge. Blessings, peace, glory and splendor be upon His loved ones and chosen ones who have arisen to serve His Cause, whom neither the swords of His enemies nor the power of the wayward among His servants could deter. They have arisen with the power of detachment and aided God, the Lord of creation. No might or power could weaken them. These are servants through whom the decree of unity was established, the banners of detachment were raised, and the light of proof shone forth through the manifestation of His glorious and wondrous Name.
selected.reason: Steadfast service amid opposition. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: O noble descendant of that illustrious man! I have chanted the verses of thy submission and humility before God, and I beseech God to encompass thee with His favors in thy travels to various regions, for thou art permitted to do so. How wonderful it would be if thou wouldst drain the dregs of every cup in the path of God. I am well pleased with thee in all matters and conditions, and I pray
selected.reason: Encouragement for travel addressed to a particular individual. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: the proof and evidence, and he chanted the verses of Thy oneness among the people of distinction, and he supplicated to the Kingdom of Thy unity with humility and assurance. How many nights did he keep vigil while the stars watched and his eyes shed tears, communing with Thee with a heart overflowing with joy, calling upon Thee in the evening and at dawn
selected.reason: Remembrance of a person’s devotional life. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: We beseech God to assist all His loved ones in that which hath dawned forth and shone resplendent from the horizons of the heavens of divine Tablets regarding the conditions of teachers. Praise be to God that in these days two deeds have become manifest from the loved ones of the lands of 'Ayn and Shin, and both have been crowned with acceptance and illumined with the light of His good-pleasure.
selected.reason: Recognizing specific accepted acts and the conditions of teaching. Selected for direct relevance and complementary thematic coverage after reading the complete catalogue wording; exact source context remains to be reviewed.

selected.text: Thou wert engaged for some time in rendering outstanding services in that most glorious spot and wert responsible for essential tasks. Thy services were praiseworthy and thine efforts pleasing. Return, now, to that land, and resume thy former services. It is hoped that, through the bounties of the All-Glorious Lord, thou wilt achieve even greater success than before, wilt cheer all the friends through distinguished services, and wilt, at all times, arise as an obedient servant to render service to the loved ones of God, for service to the loved ones of God is service to God. Glory be upon all who stand firm in the Covenant of God.
selected.reason: Mandatory authorized wording. Encourages a recipient to resume valued service and strive for greater success.
